svg.text: Smart Closet Mirror — Fig D2-4: Data model for the components finished in D2
Goal: Turn a Gen 1 Mirror into a closet mirror that measures the user with a Kinect, shows their own clothes and shop items
on their body, and tells them what to wear today and whether a new piece is worth buying.
Owners: Device, ProfileLock = Auth · ConsentEvent = L8 · Notification = Notifications · BodyModel = L3 · Decision, StylePreference, SpendEntry = L6 · ProviderAccount, CategoryRule, CacheEntry = L7.
Box = entity (one table); rows = key attributes only. Solid box = new in D2. Line = relationship; italic word reads from the first-named entity.
Cardinality at BOTH ends in crow's-foot notation, repeated as text. PK = primary key (underlined) · FK = foreign key · UQ = unique · UQ1 = unique together · IX = indexed.
No persistent data: L1, message bus, configuration (versioned files), logging (journald). Stand-alone on purpose: CacheEntry, CategoryRule, and ConsentEvent (no user link).
